read_first: state/development/banks.json when unresolved fractional development or a lazy owner cursor is relevant
for a Sword Manor anonymous cohort, load state/house/tang.json once rather than every former member record
write_order: identify the owner-specific unresolved interval from exactly one cursor: use bank resolved_through when that owner has a bank entry, otherwise use the owner development cursor
settle eligible activity with the normal capacity/recovery/relevance/difficulty law
add residual development units to the owner-specific bank only when a residual or lazy cursor is needed
consume current point_cost repeatedly for whole capability gains and recompute cost after each threshold
retain nonnegative residual units and advance the same authoritative cursor; when a bank entry exists do not also write a duplicate owner development cursor
update the authoritative learner/unit capability and rebuild a unit battle kernel when unit capability changes
for a House aggregate cohort, update its capability distribution and embedded residual credits once; persistent standouts settle individually only for hours they actually share
invariants: No progression without time and opportunity.
A bank stores development units already earned from resolved eligible activity; it never stores unearned scheduled hours.
Credits never transfer between owners or capability targets.
Each owner has exactly one authoritative development cursor; a bank entry's resolved_through supersedes and forbids a duplicate writable cursor on that exact character.
Aggregate process settled_through never erases an owner-specific unresolved development interval.
Routine training cannot manufacture field experience, combat experience, command experience, promotion, or qualification gates.
Replacement personnel do not inherit veteran experience for free.
House cohort compression is representation-neutral and cannot make anonymous members train faster than equivalent individually resolved people.
A shared House training interval is not copied into one write per anonymous member; cohort state owns the common development and sparse person-lite exceptions own only individual divergence.
